episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: After 15 years in prison, former gigolo Julian Kaye is suddenly exonerated from a wrongful murder conviction and released with no interest in the life he had, no chance at the life he wanted – and no idea who framed him. Series premiere.

episodes.title: Pretty Baby
episodes.summary: Julian's attempts to break free and start a new life of honest means are sabotaged when his old madam delivers a cryptic message about a young girl's suicide. Meanwhile, Michelle circumvents her husband to find their runaway son.

episodes.title: Rapture
episodes.summary: Julian tries to interpret a dead woman's message as Colin finds himself on the run from his father's violent associates. Meanwhile, Michelle realizes her son is in more danger than she thought – and so is Julian.

episodes.title: Nothing Is Real But the Girl
episodes.summary: Julian returns to Isabelle's fold to charm a complicated new client. Meanwhile, Michelle's past catches up to her as she attempts to save her missing son – forcing her to choose between the two loves of her life.

episodes.title: The Escape Wheel
episodes.summary: Julian leans on old friends to help track Colin's whereabouts after Michelle reveals the truth about her son. Elsewhere, Sunday tracks a new murder case threatening to rob Julian of his freedom.

episodes.title: Sunday Girl
episodes.summary: On the brink of another life sentence, Julian and Sunday wrestle with their roles in his first conviction. Elsewhere, Michelle betrays her husband, and Colin becomes a pawn for ransom.

episodes.title: Atomic
episodes.summary: Julian searches for answers. Sunday uncovers a witness who could identify Julian's original betrayer. Michelle and Richard make a play for Colin's safe return.

episodes.title: East of Eden
episodes.summary: Julian recovers Colin from an unlikely savior. Season finale.
